name: LG H&H Co., Ltd.
summary: LG H&H Co., Ltd. is a prominent South Korean enterprise with a significant international footprint, focusing on the development and distribution of cosmetics, household necessities, and beverages. Its business activities are structured across three primary divisions: Beauty, Home and Personal Care, and Refreshment. Under its Beauty segment, the company curates an extensive collection of cosmetic and skincare products. These are sold under widely recognized brand names including The History of Whoo, O HUI, SU:M37, belif, ISA KNOX, Sooryehan, CODE GLOKOLOR, VONIN, CAREZONE, The Saga of Xiu, BEYOND, Dermalift, CNP, CNP Rx, VDL, Nature Collection, THEFACESHOP, fmgt, DR.Belmeur, and Yehwadam. The Home and Personal Care division offers a broad spectrum of health and hygiene items. This comprehensive portfolio includes oral care solutions like toothpastes and toothbrushes; personal cleansing products such as soaps, various skincare items, and body washes; hair care essentials including shampoos, conditioners, and specialized treatments; laundry detergents and fabric softeners; paper-based goods like diapers and wet wipes; and an assortment of household cleaning agents for dishes, kitchens, and bathrooms. The company also supplies chemical components such as stearin and glycerin. Key brands in this category feature Elastine, ORGANIST, Reen, SILK THERAPY, ONTHEBODY, GENTOLOGY, PERIOE, BAMBOO SALT, Saffron, HANIP, TECH, Super TI, FiJi, Oxygen Clean, Homestar, SAFE, Jayeonpong, PongPong, AURA, VEILMENT, GENTOLOGY, Toddien, and Method. Furthermore, the Refreshment segment delivers a diverse selection of beverages. This encompasses sparkling water, various juices, lifestyle and sports drinks, teas, coffees, and bottled water. These are marketed through renowned brands such as Coca-Cola, Coke Zero, Coca-Cola light, Fanta, SPRITE, SPRITE KINCIDER, SCHWEPPES, MilkSoda Ambasa, Dr.Pepper, CANADA DRY, Seagram's, Seagram's THETANSAN, Minute Maid, Minute Maid sparkling, Minute Maid Qoo, Minute Maid Flower, Minute Maid Cocogummy, GEORGIA, Mate Tea of the Sun, Body Health W, GOLD PEAK, POWERADE, TORETA, ViO DIAMOND, ViO DIAMOND EC, ViO JEJU, ViO Soonsoo, Seagram's Mineral Water, GLACEAU vitamin water, Ades, HAITAI htb, and Sunkist. Beyond manufacturing and wholesale distribution, LG H&H Co., Ltd. also manages its own retail establishments. Founded in 1947, the company's corporate headquarters are situated in Seoul, South Korea.
